messages:
maria: Hey team — PR is up to connect the tracing hook example to the new dashboard widgets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123. Need a reviewer and a quick QA plan.
ryan: Taking a look now. failing snippet test on CI (embed-sample mismatch) — will push a fix in a bit.
docbot: CI queued for build 1289 — docs-snippets tests.
sasha: Also we need to update the rollout notes for the console nav — users reported the old 'traces' route 404s after the schema change. Can we add a redirect mention?
maria: yes — add a small migration note. @kevin can you update the JS/py SDK snippets to use the new `trace_id` field? Example below:
kevin: on it. I'll replace the old `trace` object with `trace_id` and add a short explanation about sampling rates.
alisa: For the cost/latency breakdown example, the query needs to use `metrics.cost_per_token` and `metrics.avg_latency_ms`. Current snippet uses `cost_per_token_usd` which is deprecated. Proposed snippet:
```sql
SELECT model, SUM(metrics.tokens) AS total_tokens, AVG(metrics.avg_latency_ms) AS avg_latency
FROM dashboard.events
WHERE ts > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
GROUP BY model
```
ryan: pushed a tiny patch to fix the snippet link + tests — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/abc123. CI rerun.
docbot: CI passed — docs-snippets tests. :white_check_mark:
maria: Great — plan to merge after a 15-min codefreeze window at 16:00 PST. Anyone object?
sasha: No objections. I'll do a manual smoke test on staging after merge.
kevin: I'll publish the SDK snippet updates in the same PR, and add a short note about quantization interactions with latency metrics.
alisa: heads-up: will need to update the telemetry dashboard widget ids in the console migration guide. I'll open a followup issue.
maria: Thanks all. After merge I'll post a short note in #announcements and ping the support team. :tada:
